title: WHEN FEAR STRIKES
GOD IS YOUR SHIELD
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering

scenes.a: That sharp sudden fear caught you off guard.
scenes.sub: THAT THREAT CAUGHT YOU OFF GUARD

scenes.a: When unexpected threats disturb your spirit, turn immediately to the Lord's strong tower.
What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee. In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
scenes.sub: WHAT TIME I AM AFRAID I TRUST THEE

scenes.a: Father, whenever trembling grips this heart, we anchor our reliance squarely in Your unfailing righteousness.
Shield us from human malice, quiet every racing thought, and cover us under Your wings.
Give us steady boldness today, knowing mortal man cannot dismantle what You protect.
Amen. That sharp sudden fear caught you off guard.
